name: Yung Lean
description:
'''Jonatan Aron Leandoer Håstad''' (born 18 July 1996), known professionally as '''Yung Lean''', is a Swedish rapper and singer. Known for his [[Experimental hip hop|experimental]] approach to [[hip-hop]], Yung Lean has been widely credited as a pioneer of the [[cloud rap]] and [[emo rap]] genres.

Yung Lean rose to prominence in 2013 with his song "[[Ginseng Strip 2002]]", which went [[Viral video|viral]] on [[YouTube]]. He released the mixtapes ''[[Unknown Death 2002]]'' (2013), ''[[Frost God]]'' (2016), ''Poison Ivy'' (2018) and ''[[Stardust (mixtape)|Stardust]]'' (2022), and the studio albums ''[[Unknown Memory]]'' (2014), ''[[Warlord (Yung Lean album)|Warlord]]'' (2016), ''[[Stranger (Yung Lean album)|Stranger]]'' (2017), [[Starz (Yung Lean album)|''Starz'']] (2020), ''[[Psykos]]'' (2024) and ''[[Jonatan (album)|Jonatan]]'' (2025). He has also released music under the [[pseudonym]] '''Jonatan Leandoer96''', exploring genres outside his established hip-hop sound. Alongside producers [[Gud (music producer)|Yung Gud]] and [[Yung Sherman]], he is a founding member of the Swedish musical collective Sad Boys.
